d:
Security forces have killed Lashkar-e-Taiba commander Latif Bhat in an encounter in Jammu and Kashmir's Kulgam district on November 18. Bhat was reportedly hiding inside a mosque after an exchange of fire. Security personnel even attempted to persuade him to surrender through a video call, but he refused. He was allegedly involved in the November 11 attack on a CRPF checkpoint that left three personnel injured. How did the encounter unfold, and what happened before it?
